contract_traces.trace: a2 HairLods::build creates nonempty levels from one shared shuffled order; private StrandLevel columns carry StrandShape. contract_traces.family: Native source, layout and allocation provenance
contract_traces.trace: 0df GpuLevel fields seal actual Device/layout/Buffer, GpuLods builder retains first Arc. a6 GpuSim::make_sim checks first device, creates binding/rest/current/body resources from actual context and retains same Arc/layout. Root set_gpu_groom checks Device and records actual first Arc. set_gpu_dynamics checks installed Arc/device, complete native ranges/capabilities; set_moved checks same source/layout and each exact buffer Arc plus actual body range before publishing pose/offset.
contract_traces.guarantees: Same count or common adapter alone cannot admit foreign capture; a different simulation allocation requires deliberate reinstall. Metres retained until DeformGpu offset extraction.
contract_traces.limits: Internal producer sealed provenance is the authority; root does not fake a context or independently certify GPU construction success.

contract_traces.family: Logical data, positive native binding and copy extents

Host inputs reserve/pack Vec4 bytes before upload; body absent owns one nonaccessed vec4. preflight checks all resident positions/rest and parameter uniform limit before copy/installation/clear.

contract_traces.limits: Native byte arrays/POD/SDK usage flags are explicit adapters; body ABI belongs to producer actual Buffer.size, not duplicated17-record arithmetic.

contract_traces.trace: Candidate inputs/level rest resources and bind groups are built before native queue submission, then Dynamics/pose publish. clear absent is idempotent; present preflights then submits before dropping Dynamics/resetting pose. record_deformations uses retained canonical layout and body payload, returns RecordedDeformations; render publishes deformation/frame state only after normal submit.
contract_traces.guarantees: Mode/body enums own correlated payloads, typed layout/prefix/allocation causes flow through RenderSimulationError into actual HairGpuError Backend cause chain; no new production unwrap/unsafe/suppression or compatibility path.
